name: Shandong Donghong Pipe Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Donghong Pipe Industry Co., Ltd., headquartered in Qufu, China, and founded in 1997, is a Chinese enterprise dedicated to the research, development, production, and maintenance of various pipeline systems. The company offers a broad array of piping solutions, including SRTP, polyethylene composite, and PVC pipe systems, alongside insulation pipes, anti-corrosion metal pipes, and related pipe connections. Beyond finished products, Shandong Donghong also innovates and manufactures crucial materials for pipeline construction, such as adhesive resins, polyolefin wear-resistant compounds, 3PE pipeline corrosion protection, epoxy resin anti-corrosion powder, phosphorus flame retardants, anti-static flame-retardant polyethylene, and other auxiliary pipe materials. Their engineering pipeline offerings and complete contracting solutions are widely employed in significant undertakings across national municipal, water conservancy, industrial and mining, and thermal sectors.
